name: ZJMI Environmental Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: ZJMI Environmental Energy Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, sells coal products in China and internationally. It operates through three segments: Coal Distribution, Combined Heat and Power, and New Energy. The company engages in coal mining, circulation, and consumption, as well as offers thermal and coking coals; and generation of steam and compressed air through burning coal, biomass, and sludge, as well as provides general solid waste disposal services. It is also involved in the investment, construction, operation, management, and EPC general contracting services for wind, solar, and energy storage charging stations; research, development, production, and sale of energy storage …
